intro.content:
## Google Antigravity monitoring

Agent, tool and step spans from the Antigravity SDK's OpenTelemetry hooks, plus the token usage and duration metrics derived from them by the collector.

[Example](https://github.com/dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-ai-agent-instrumentation-examples/tree/main/ai-coding-agents/antigravity) | [SDK](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-sdk-python)

invocations.title: Agent invocations
invocations.query:
fetch spans, from: now()-1h
| filter matchesValue(service.name, "antigravity*")
| filter gen_ai.operation.name == "invoke_agent"
| summarize count = count()

tools.title: Tool executions
tools.query:
fetch spans, from: now()-1h
| filter matchesValue(service.name, "antigravity*")
| filter gen_ai.operation.name == "execute_tool"
| summarize count = count()

errors.title: Failed spans
errors.query:
fetch spans, from: now()-1h
| filter matchesValue(service.name, "antigravity*")
| filter span.status_code == "error"
| summarize count = count()

total_tokens.title: Total tokens
total_tokens.query:
timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage), from: now()-1h
| fieldsAdd total = arraySum(tokens)
| summarize total = sum(total)

tokens_by_type.title: Tokens by direction
tokens_by_type.query: timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage), by: { gen_ai.token.type }, from: now()-1h

tokens_by_model.title: Tokens by model
tokens_by_model.query: timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage), by: { gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.token.type }, from: now()-1h

client_latency.title: Client operation duration
client_latency.query: timeseries duration = avg(gen_ai.client.operation.duration), by: { gen_ai.request.model }, from: now()-1h

agent_latency.title: Agent invocation duration
agent_latency.query: timeseries duration = avg(gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration), by: { gen_ai.agent.name }, from: now()-1h

tool_latency.title: Tool execution duration
tool_latency.query: timeseries duration = avg(gen_ai.execute_tool.duration), by: { gen_ai.tool.name }, from: now()-1h

steps.title: Steps per turn
steps.query:
fetch spans, from: now()-1h
| filter matchesValue(service.name, "antigravity*")
| filter isNotNull(antigravity.step.index)
| summarize steps = count(), by: { trace.id }
| summarize avg_steps = avg(steps)

prompts.title: Prompts and responses
prompts.query:
fetch spans, from: now()-1h
| filter matchesValue(service.name, "antigravity*")
| filter gen_ai.operation.name == "invoke_agent"
| fields timestamp, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, duration, trace.id
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 25

recent.title: Recent Antigravity spans
recent.query:
fetch spans, from: now()-1h
| filter matchesValue(service.name, "antigravity*")
| fields timestamp, span.name, gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.tool.name, duration, span.status_code, trace.id
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 50
